$comment: Single source of truth for the Avatar API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person's picture, with their initials when there's no picture.
thumb: GH

name.description: Who it is. Becomes the accessible name, and the initials when there is no picture.

src.description: Picture URL. If it fails to load, the initials show.

status.description: A presence dot. Say it in the name too: "Ada Lovelace (online)".

examples.title: Picture, initials and status
examples.description: A picture, the initials fallback, a square avatar for teams and a presence dot. A picture that fails to load shows the initials underneath.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Small (28px), medium (36px) and large (48px). Initials scale with the size.

examples.title: Group
examples.description: Avatars overlap with a ring in the background colour. End with a count for the rest.

a11y: The avatar has role="img" and the person's name as its aria-label; the picture inside has alt="" so the name is read once.
The initials and the status dot are part of the image, so screen readers don't read them on their own. Put the status in the name.
Initials meet 4.5:1 contrast in every style and mode.
A "+3" counter gets a name like "3 more people".
